refinementNotes: LC/LP/LB and some visible instrument centers are medium-confidence 062 measurements because runtime code exposes exact effect points only for HH/SN/BD/HT/LT/FT/RC/RD.
Neutral human landmarks are SOFT visual measurements with explicit tolerances; they are not hard pixel locks.
Future automated landmark extraction may tighten these soft values if it does not contradict PASS references or fixed camera identity.
